name: Enterprise Network Diagnostics Suite
description: Enterprise network latency and packet loss troubleshooting suite featuring hop-by-hop MTR path analysis, subnet performance calculators, IP range scanning, advanced protocol tools (DNS DoH, TCP Mathis/BDP, PMTUD MTU/MSS, BGP Looking Glass, VoIP E-Model MOS, IPv6 SLAAC), and exportable PDF diagnostic reports.
